items.title: Emerson Lands 13-Year Equinor Deal to Optimize Operations
items.summary: Emerson Electric Co. (NYSE:EMR) said Monday it entered a long-term strategic collaboration with Equinor ASA (NYSE:EQNR) to supply measurement technologies and services across the energy company’s global offshore and onshore operations. The 13-year frame agreement, including options, will expand the companies’ existing automation partnership.
